statement.text:
b) Let G be a finitely generated residually finite group, d(G) the minimal
number of its generators, and δ(G) the minimal number of topological generators
of the profinite completion of G. It is known that there exist groups G for which
d(G) > δ(G) (G. A. Noskov, Math. Notes, 33, no. 4 (1983), 249–254). Is the function
d bounded on the set of groups G with the fixed value of δ(G) ⩾ 2? O. V. Mel’nikov
